sections.title: A bit about Taxdown
texts: Taxdown is a software company that helps people file their tax returns easily.
TaxDown uses Sttok to manage its incentive plans and its relationship with shareholders: meetings and the shareholder register.

sections.title: Why did they choose us?
texts: 1. For the ease of use of the platform.
2. For the automation of manual tasks.
3. For the management of the shareholder register.
5. For the management of Incentive Plans.
